function formGuideService() {
    return {
        /* ---------- STATE ---------- */
        form_guides: [],
        loading: false,
        error: false,
        empty: false,
        controller: null,

        /* =====================================
        INIT
        ===================================== */
        init() {
            this.load()
        },
        /* =====================================
        COLOR BADGE
        ===================================== */
        colorBadgeForm(type) {
            return {
                'W': 'badge-form-win',
                'D': 'badge-form-draw',
                'L': 'badge-form-lose'
            } [type]
        },

        /* =====================================
        LOAD DATA
        ===================================== */
        async load() {
            if (this.loading) return

            this.loading = true
            this.error = false
            this.empty = false

            if (this.controller) this.controller.abort()
            this.controller = new AbortController()

            try {
                const res = await fetch(
                    `/ajax/nearestPerformance.json?ids[]=x7lm7ph9e40m2wd`, {
                        signal: this.controller.signal
                    }
                )

                if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Network error')

                const json = await res.json()
                console.log('API RESULT >>>', json)

                // if (!json.success) {
                //     this.empty = true
                //     return
                // }

                this.form_guides = json['x7lm7ph9e40m2wd'] || []
                this.empty = this.form_guides.length === 0
            } catch (e) {
                if (e.name !== 'AbortError') {
                    console.error(e)
                    this.error = true
                }
            } finally {
                this.loading = false
            }
        },

    }
}
document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
    Alpine.store('info_team_store', {
        data: null,
        isLoading: false,
        
        async fetch(team_id) {
            this.isLoading = true;
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`https://api.cafescore.com/v2/football/teams/${team_id}`, {
                    headers: {
                        "x-client-timestamp": window.x_client_time,
                        "x-client-signature": window.x_client_sig,
                    }
                });
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch info team');
                const json = await res.json();
                this.data = json.data;
                console.log('info_team',this.data);
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error fetching info team:', err);
            } finally {
                this.isLoading = false;
            }
        }
    });
});
function info_team({ team_id }) {
    return {
        team_id,
        
        init() {
            if (!this.$store.info_team_store.data) {
                this.$store.info_team_store.fetch(this.team_id);
            }
        },
        
        get infoTeam() {
            return this.$store.info_team_store.data;
        },
        
        get isLoading() {
            return this.$store.info_team_store.isLoading;
        },

        changeFormatDate(timestamp) {
            if (!timestamp) return '-';

            const date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);

            const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
            const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
            const year = date.getFullYear();

            return day+'/'+month+'/'+year;
        },
        formatCurrency(value) {
            if (!value) return '';

            let result;

            if (value >= 1_000_000_000) {
                result = value / 1_000_000_000;
                return parseFloat(result.toFixed(2)) + 'B';
            } else if (value >= 1_000_000) {
                result = value / 1_000_000;
                return parseFloat(result.toFixed(2)) + 'M';
            } else {
                result = value / 1_000;
                return parseFloat(result.toFixed(2)) + 'K';
            }
        },
        
    };
}
